svg.title: The West Bank in pieces, Gaza behind a yellow line
svg.desc: Situation map covering 33.9°E to 36.0°E, 30.9°N to 33.4°N. The Oslo areas, the settlements and Gaza under Israeli military presence, 2026. Areas of control in 8 classes: Area A (Palestinian civil and security control), Area B (Palestinian civil, Israeli security control), Area C (Israeli civil and security control), East Jerusalem (annexed by Israel, not recognised), Israeli settlements, Gaza: Israeli military presence (OCHA, April 2026), Gaza: rest of the Strip, Occupied Syrian Golan. An approximate front line is drawn. Oslo areas, settlements, the Gaza military-presence area and the yellow line are OCHA oPt's layers as published on its server, which declares no licence: every zone is drawn as OCHA reported it, not assessed independently; no claimed-only ground is shown. Names follow UN usage: the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and the occupied Syrian Golan; the 1980 and 1981 annexations are not recognised (UN Security Council resolutions 478 and 497). © OCHA oPt (gis.unocha.org, 2024–2026); Golan and Israel: OpenHistoricalMap relations 2734971, 2863757 (CC0); Natural Earth basemap. Positions as of March–April 2026. 8 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
